claims.statement: Animal feed FY25 EBIT per ton expected to exceed FY24 average of Rs 1,531/ton
CDMO revenue to maintain ~67% growth run-rate in FY25 with base now over Rs 250 Cr
Dairy VAP salience targeted to grow another 4-5% in FY25 from 36%
Cattle and Fish feed volumes expected to sustain double-digit growth for foreseeable future
Branded poultry share to reach 80%+ earlier than FY28 target
Consolidated capex run-rate of Rs 250-300 Cr to be maintained in FY25; oil palm refinery expansion decision by end of Q2
Astec herbicide plant commissioned in Q1; further capex tied to CDMO pickup in Q3-Q4
Dairy plant utilisation to rise from 60% to 75-80% over next 2 years via geography saturation
Oil palm refinery and solvent extraction capacities to match in-house production within 2 years
Animal feed Q4 EBIT/ton reached Rs 1,874; upward trend expected to continue near Q4 levels
Standalone Crop Protection segment margin 31% in FY24, 3.4x FY23
Branded poultry contribution margins: Yummy's ~35%, Real Good Chicken ~15% vs live bird -25% to +25%
Oil palm value addition limited PBT decline to ~20% despite 20% CPO price drop
Astec CDMO new products commercializing from July-August FY25; revenue contribution to start then
Animal Feed EBIT/MT improved to ₹2,258 in Q1 FY25 from ₹1,443 in Q1 FY24
Animal Feed segment margins improved to 6.8% in Q1 FY25 from 4.2% in Q1 FY24
Standalone Crop Protection segment margins improved to 45% in Q1 FY25 from 32% in Q1 FY24
Dairy EBITDA margins improved by 490 basis points in Q1 FY25
Consolidated EBITDA margins expected at 9-10% for remaining quarters of FY25
Animal Feed EBIT/MT expected around ₹2,000 for remaining quarters of FY25
CDMO revenue guidance maintained at ₹260-270 crore base growing 60-70% YoY for FY25
Astec enterprise demand expected to recover fully by end of FY25, export prices may take 1-2 more quarters to firm up
₹110 crore Animal Feed plant sanctioned in Maharashtra, completion in ~2 years
Additional ₹70-80 crore for OPP refinery and herbicide plant capitalization in FY25
No new capex committed for Astec beyond debottlenecking, quality, and environmental projects
CDMO order deferrals due to China supply chain issues, revenue to be realized in Q2
Consolidated EBITDA margins excluding non-recurring items improved 70 bps YoY in Q2 FY25; excluding Astec, improvement was 130 bps.
Animal Feed segment margins improved from 4.6% to 5.9% YoY in Q2 FY25; EBIT per metric ton rose from ₹1,531 to ₹1,953.
Standalone Crop Protection segment margins improved from 30% to 43% YoY in Q2 FY25 due to lower doubtful debts and fixed cost control.
Dairy segment EBITDA margins improved by 140 bps YoY in Q2 FY25 driven by operational efficiency and improved milk spread.
Astec CDMO revenue targeting ~₹400 crore in FY25, implying ~50% YoY growth over FY24 base of ~₹270 crore.
Astec CDMO FY25 revenue guidance of 50% YoY growth maintained; H1 was lower but H2 catch-up expected due to seasonal shift in buying behavior.
Astec Herbicide 2 plant commissioned on time in Q2 FY25; expected to run at ~30% capacity in FY25, reaching 60-70% utilization only in FY26.
Astec Herbicide 2 plant capacity utilization assumptions pushed by 1-2 years; upwards of 60-70% utilization expected only in FY26.
Astec targeting break-even in H2 FY25 (profitable in Q4) if 1-2 more CDMO contracts under negotiation materialize.
EBITDA margins (excl. non-recurring) improved 200 bps YoY in Q3 FY25
Animal Feed EBIT/Tn improved 45% YoY to ₹1,925 in Q3 FY25
Animal Feed EBIT/Tn expected over ₹2,100 in Q4 FY25 and ₹1,800-2,000 in FY26
Astec CDMO FY25 expected flat YoY (~₹270 cr); FY26 guided 30-35% growth with confirmed orders
Astec CDMO FY26 growth guidance 40% YoY; prices stabilizing after China bottom-out
Vegetable Oil Q3 FY25 revenue up 45% YoY on higher CPO/PKO prices and improved OER despite flat FFB arrivals
Vegetable Oil outlook bullish due to Indonesia B20 mandate, 20% import duty, and lower global production
Dairy Q3 EBITDA dropped 5.4% YoY due to sudden milk procurement price hike; consumer price increase taken 21 Jan; Q4 expected better
Poultry plants at 90% utilisation; aim to upsell and expand RGC margins by couple of points in FY26
Consolidated capex ₹161 cr in 9M FY25; full year FY25 ~₹220 cr; similar plan for FY26
Palm oil area expansion 13,000-14,000 hectares in FY25 (2.5x last year); can repeat for 4-5 years
Astec Enterprise business FY26 volume growth expected 14-16%; cautious inventory management for accretive margins
Consolidated top-line and bottom-line growth guided at 16-18% for FY26
Animal Feed EBIT per ton expected at INR 1,900-2,000 for FY26
Astec CDMO revenue growth guided at ~35% YoY for next couple of years
Astec enterprise gross margin expected at 20-23% for FY26
Astec enterprise contribution margin expected at 12-14% for FY26
Astec EBITDA expected to turn positive in FY26
Crop Protection EBITDA margin expected 25-30% in 3 years
Dairy EBITDA margin expected to expand to 6-7% in FY26 from 5% in FY25
Dairy value-added product salience expected to reach 40%+ in FY26
Dairy direct procurement target 75% in FY26
FFB arrivals expected to grow ~18% in FY26
Animal Feed volume growth expected at 7-8% blended in FY26
No capex planned for Astec in FY26; GAVL capex focused on Oil Palm Plantation refineries and value-added products
Palm kernel oil refinery under progress, likely operational by end of season or next year
Hydrogenation and interesterification plant under discussion for B2B food products
Astec CDMO contract manufacturing POs and negotiations for H1 largely completed, giving confidence of normal demand
Consolidated EBITDA margin ex-nonrecurring improved 110 bps in FY25 despite flat revenue
Animal Feed segment margin improved sharply from 4.6% to 6.1% in FY25
Crop Protection segment margin at 40% in FY25
Vegetable Oil margin expansion from 15% to 17% in FY25 driven by higher CPO/PKO prices and forward integration
Consolidated top-line growth maintained at early teens for FY26
Profit growth expectation maintained for FY26 after 25% YoY growth in Q1
Astec LifeSciences targeting EBITDA break-even and Rs 500 crore turnover in FY26
Astec CDMO revenue target over Rs 300 crore (65% of sales) in FY26; aim to grow >30% annually beyond
PKO refinery to start in Q3 FY26; inter-esterification and hydrogenation in Q4 FY26 for bakery fats
FFB arrivals up 52% YoY to 178k tons in Q1 FY26; full year FY26 growth expected 15-18% over FY25's 536k tons
Oil extraction ratio 18.37% in Q1 FY26 vs 17.98% YoY; expected to be better than FY25's 19% for full year
Refinery incremental profit 1-1.5% depending on prices; will decide monthly whether to sell CPO or refined oil
Dairy EBITDA margin including working media at 6.5-7% for FY26; excluding media 5.5-6% annually
Vegetable Oil segment revenue and margins improved significantly on higher CPO/PKO realizations, 50% higher FFB arrivals, better OER
Standalone Crop Protection revenue grew 5% YoY on in-house volume growth; margins marginally lower due to channel mix and discounts
Astec LifeSciences revenue up 31% YoY on higher Enterprise and CDMO volumes; EBITDA improved on volumes, lower RM costs, better utilization
Poultry revenue and margins declined on lower live bird volumes and muted realizations; focusing on branded business
Farmer households target 4,000 for FY26 social security benefits
Farmer engagement target 1,500 for FY26
Dairy farmers engagement target 13,000 for FY26
Students training target 17,000 for FY26 in modern agriculture
Astec LifeSciences maintains guidance of ~INR500 crore revenue and EBITDA breakeven for FY26.
Vegetable Oil margins expanded to 22.4% in Q2 driven by higher CPO/PKO realizations and record oil extraction ratio.
Standalone Crop Protection margins compressed to 23.3% from 43.1% YoY due to excessive rainfall and lower acreages.
Astec enterprise margins ~15%, CDMO margins 30-31%; overall gross margin ~44% in Q2 but fixed cost absorption limited by low revenue.
Oil palm planting at very high level this year; benefits visible after 4-5 years.
Astec R&D centre operating at ~90% capacity utilization with 100 fume hoods and ~100 scientists; 12 molecules in pipeline.
Astec plant utilization doubled over last 3 quarters; near breakeven utilization across sites.
Astec LifeSciences targets EBITDA breakeven for FY26 and revenue around INR5 billion
Astec LifeSciences targets 15% revenue growth for FY27
Vegetable Oil business expects FFB tonnage CAGR of 12-15% over long term
Crop Protection domestic business targets 28-30% margin range in midterm
New CPO processing plant in Khammam to go live in 2 months; downstream refinery to be commissioned in Q1 next year
Pet food plant ready for commissioning in about a month
Expanded oil palm acreage by 15,000 hectares in 9M FY26, targeting 17,000-18,000 hectares for full year
Animal Feed underlying EBIT per metric ton improved to INR2,020 in Q3 FY26 from INR1,937 in Q3 FY25
Vegetable Oil segment revenue grew 27% YoY and segment results grew 25% YoY in Q3 FY26
Astec LifeSciences EBITDA turned positive at INR5 crores in Q3 FY26 vs loss in Q3 FY25
Creamline Dairy EBITDA declined to INR11 crores with margins at 3% due to higher milk procurement cost
Godrej Foods EBITDA grew 51% YoY to INR17 crores with margins expanding to 8% in Q3 FY26
Capital advances Rs 18.1 crore
FY27 consolidated early double-digit revenue growth and mid-teens PBT growth targeted
claims.value: early double-digit revenue growth; mid-teens PBT growth

claims.statement: Animal Nutrition targeting double-digit revenue growth led by volume in FY27
Crop Care FY27 recovery year with very high double-digit top and bottom line growth from Q2
Creamline Dairy milk procurement prices expected to normalize from Q2 FY27
Godrej Foods targeting double-digit growth in branded portfolio in FY27
Oil Palm targeting early double-digit volume growth and record area expansion in FY27
Astec targeting ~15% top-line growth with CDMO growing higher; margins intact
Animal Nutrition Q4 margin boosted by INR9.5 cr pet food manufacturing profit
Oil Palm Q4 FY26 OER 20.77% on 60k tons FFB vs 19.76% YoY; annual FFB 6.37 lakh tons
Capex to continue at Rs 300-350 Cr per year, funded through internal accruals
Majority of growth capex allocated towards high-margin, high ROCE businesses
Oil Palm FFB volume growth targeted at high single-digit to early double-digit over next 4-5 years
Oil Palm downstream value-added business expected to add ~200 bps to overall EBITDA profile when fully scaled
Overall capex guidance of INR300-350 crores includes integrated palm oil complex and specialty fats refinery
Astec LifeSciences full-year revenue growth guidance raised to at least 20% from earlier ~20%
Consolidated PBT growth guidance revised from mid-teens to double-digit for FY27
Crop Care EBIT margin expected to hold at 26-27% despite diversification into lower-margin in-licensed products
Animal Nutrition EBIT per tonne guidance maintained at INR2,050-2,150 range
Oil Palm area expansion added 17,000 hectares last year, on track for similar addition this year; targeting 150,000 hectares from ~80,000
Astec CDMO margins intact; enterprise margins normalizing after temporary raw material advantage
Oil Palm capex investments meet 16-18% IRR hurdle rate
Solar rooftops at >20 manufacturing sites; ~7,500 MWh generated in H1 FY27
Management intends to chase double-digit PBT growth for FY27 but acknowledges it has become tougher due to El Niño impact on agchem and palm oil price volatility.
Oil palm business targets a healthy double-digit EBITDA CAGR for FY27 and the midterm.
Oil palm downstream integration expected to add roughly 2 percentage points to segment EBITDA margin over a two-to-four-year midterm period.
Oil palm FFB volume growth guidance of double-digits for FY27 maintained despite weather challenges.
Oil palm OER target for FY27 is to recover to 19.7%+ annualized level after weather-related dip in Q2.
Consolidated EBITDA stable at INR222 crores with 7.4% margin despite significant cost inflation.
Animal nutrition segment profit grew 32% with margin improvement from favourable mix and operating efficiencies.
Dairy profitability affected by elevated milk procurement, packaging, and logistics costs; no respite expected for next two quarters.
Godrej Foods EBITDA plus working media margin expanded 20 bps to 5.8% despite hyperinflation in feed costs.
Ashitaka® maize herbicide launch on track to cross INR100 crores revenue in first year.
Crop care pipeline targets seven crop segments by FY29-30 to reduce dependence on cotton and chili.
Astec CDMO funnel strong with 90% inquiry-to-R&D conversion and 15 products in R&D pipeline.
Oil palm integrated complex in Khammam commissioned with mill, CPKO refinery, and biogas plant; hydrogenation and fractionation to come in December.
Added 13,000 hectares of oil palm plantations in H1 FY27.
PKO derivatives plant commissioned 1st September; meaningful financial impact expected from Q4 FY27, scaling in FY28.
